title: Normalized local Frobenius coefficient and point-return data
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$, its geometric fibre $Y$, and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $E$ and $M$ be arbitrary finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra homomorphism $\iota:E\to M$. Use the raw rational constructible categories, derived pullbacks and coefficient extensions [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and fix an integral comparison system $C$ with the stipulated realization normalization [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Use the realization-normalized rational compositor and scalar comparison of [def-trf-realized-pullback-comparisons], with the following component formulas. Let $Q_E$ be raw rationalization and $\theta_{f,K}:Lf_E^*K\simeq Q_E(Lf_{\mathcal O_E}^*K.obj)$ the prescribed object comparison [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. The constructible compositor is the restriction of the integral compositor of $C$, and its rational compositor $c^C_{h,k,K}$ is, in left-to-right order, $\theta_{hk,K}$ followed by $Q_E(c^C_{h,k,K.obj})$, then $\theta_{h,Q_E(k^*K.obj)}^{-1}$, then $Lh_E^*(\theta_{k,K}^{-1})$. The rational pullback/scalar comparison $a^C_f:T_{M/E}Lf_E^*\simeq Lf_M^*T_{M/E}$ is the unique natural isomorphism whose components, under the prescribed object identifications, are the rationalizations of the integral $\lambda$ followed by $\mu^{-1}$ of $C$. These formulas apply to morphisms between schemes where $\ell$ is invertible.

For $z:s\to Y$, define the coefficient point-fibre functor
$$P_{E,z}=\operatorname{Fib}_E\circ Lz_E^*:D^b_c(Y,E)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E),$$
using the actual point rational fibre $\operatorname{Fib}_E$ and its sections/scalar comparison $\phi$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Define $S_{M/E}=T_{M/E,Y}$, define $d_{r+1}=a^C_{g_Y^{r+1}}$ for $r\in\mathbf N$, and define
$$b_{E,M,z,K}=\operatorname{Fib}_M(a^C_{z,K})\circ\phi^{-1}_{Lz_E^*K}:R_{M/E}P_{E,z}K\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{M,z}S_{M/E}K.$$
Here $R_{M/E}$ is ordinary finite-dimensional point-complex scalar extension. The positive-power pullback is the existing $P_r=L(g_Y^{r+1})^*$ of [def-fd-specified-weil-iterate].

For completeness the underlying return map is part of these data, not an unspecified map supplied by a theorem. Write $g_s=\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Frob}_q)$ and let $i_N:\operatorname{Fib}_E(N)\to\operatorname{Fib}_E(Lg_s^*N)$ be the one-step point transport [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. Define successive positive point transports by
$$I^C_0(N)=i_N,\qquad I^C_{r+1}(N)=\operatorname{Fib}_E((c^C_{g_s^{r+1},g_s,N})^{-1})\circ I^C_r(Lg_s^*N)\circ i_N.$$
Given $r\in\mathbf N$, $z:s\to Y$ and the semilinear return equation $w:g_s^{r+1}\mathbin{;}z=z\mathbin{;}g_Y^{r+1}$, define the return isomorphism $\rho^C_{r,z,w,K}$ from $L(g_s^{r+1})^*Lz^*K$ to $Lz^*L(g_Y^{r+1})^*K$ by $(c^C_{g_s^{r+1},z,K})^{-1}$, equality transport along $w$, and $c^C_{z,g_Y^{r+1},K}$ in that order. Put
$$J^C_{r,z,w,K}=\operatorname{Fib}_E(\rho^C_{r,z,w,K})\circ I^C_r(Lz^*K).$$
For $x\in Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^{r+1}})$, define $\operatorname{returnTransport}_{E,C,r,x,K}$ to be this $J^C$ at its induced $z=\bar x$ and the canonical semilinear return equation of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. All data apply to every underlying rational constructible complex and every rational morphism. No Weil structure, separatedness, stable integral lattice, finite Tor-amplitude condition, or equality $g_Y^{r+1}\bar x=\bar x$ is assumed.
